text: We’re making a giant fort in the living room today. It’s going to be awesome! First, we grabbed all the blankets from my bed. "Don't take the blue one!" yelled my little brother. Oh man! He is so annoying sometimes. But we took it anyway. We used the couch cushions for the walls and draped the sheets over the top. It looked like a castle. Wow! We crawled inside with flashlights and pretended we were hiding from dragons. No way were those dragons getting us! It’s the best fort ever.

Last week my dad took me and his friend’s daughter to the park. We pretended we were on a secret island looking for treasure. I ran straight to the big slide, but then I got caught on my shoelace and fell down! It didn’t hurt though. I got up and yelled, "I am a brave knight!" We played until we thought it was time for ice cream. It was the best day ever.

I can't believe we found it! My brother Leo and I were digging in the backyard, just looking for worms, when my shovel hit something hard. Clink! We dug faster. "No way!" Leo shouted. It was an old metal box covered in dirt. We’re going to be rich! I tried to open the lid, but it was stuck tight. Oh man! We need a screwdriver or something. "Mom! Come look!" I yelled. It's probably full of gold coins or a pirate map. I hope it’s not just empty. Wow! What a cool day.

My big sister acted like a brave **knight** in our game yesterday. We pretended the backyard was a scary **island** full of monsters. I ran **straight** at the big tree, but my shoelace got **caught** on a root and I fell down! I **thought** I was going to cry, but she helped me up. " Are you brave **enough** to keep going?" she asked me. I said yes, and then we ran all the way **through** the bushes to find the hidden treasure. It was just a shiny rock.

My friend Tim and I played a game in the backyard. Tim pretended to be a brave **knight** with a shiny sword made of cardboard. He said we were stuck on a deserted **island** full of monsters. I ran **straight** for the big oak tree to hide, but then Tim **caught** me! We laughed so hard until my mom yelled that it was time for dinner. I **thought** we could play forever, but I was actually hungry **enough** to eat a whole pizza by myself.

Today was a very good day. I woke up early and ate toast for breakfast. Then I went to the park with my dad. We played catch with a big red ball. I ran very fast and got hot. We saw a cute dog there too. For lunch, I had a sandwich and some juice. Later, I read my favorite book about space. Now I am tired and ready for bed. It was the best day ever. I hope tomorrow is fun too.

It is super scary but also very funny when we get caught. Yesterday, we built a huge castle in Minecraft instead. It had a secret room full of diamonds! After that, my mom said we had to stop looking at screens. So we played with my Pokemon cards on the floor. I traded my Pikachu for his Charizard, and it was the best day ever.

It’s finally summer break! Oh man, I can’t wait to go to the pool every single day. My best friend Leo says he’s going to learn how to do a backflip off the diving board, but I don't believe him. No way! He’s scared of heights. We’re going to get ice cream later, too. Chocolate with sprinkles. My favorite. I hope my mom lets me stay up late tonight to catch fireflies in the backyard. It’s going to be the best summer ever!

Spider-Man is super cool because he can shoot webs. I wish I could play games all day long.

"I **caught** a dragon!" We ran **through** the tall grass until we got tired. "That was **enough** running," I said. My mom called us for dinner, so we went **straight** inside to eat pizza. It was the best day ever.

Oh man, it was funny. "You can't even steer!" I yelled. He got mad and said, "It's lagging!" No way! He just stinks at driving. We’re going to play again later, and I bet I’ll beat him. I don't even need practice. Just pure skill! I can't wait to see his face when I win.

Now we’re both covered in mud because my brother slipped trying to chase it. Mom’s going to be so mad, but it was totally worth it. That frog was awesome.
